text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Y-you actually... retrieved the airplane?
Huh? But that means you
spoke with...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Your old teacher to borrow the truck,
yeah. Look, I understand how you feel, but
could you take a look at the
plane
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I think... you'll learn a lot from it.
A lot of
important lessons.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
...
It's so beat up... Oh, but the internal
workings are...

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! Not a single broken pipe! Me
and my teacher went through a lot of trial
and error to find something that could
best withstand the
internal pressure!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Aah, this durability... So his theory was
correct! Does that mean the
cylinders are
okay too?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So, hey. Why'd you use two layers of glass
for the cockpit window? It
makes it harder
to see outside, and it makes the plane
heavier!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's because my teacher gets cold
easily! We used
double-paned glass to
keep the elements from getting in the
plane.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
We compensated with lighter seats and
instruments, but it wasn't easy! See those
stitches? If you cut along the seam and
take out the
insides...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
The stitching in this spot is all over
the place! What other
customizations did
you make?

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
...Everything.
All of it! Every part of this
plane is filled with the quirks
of me and my
teacher!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I remember now... He'd always smile while
he was working... You
could feel the
childlike excitement rolling off him in
waves.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
He'd talk with such fervor about flying
beyond the mountains! And I
thought we'd
soar over them together, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You can still be the torchbearer of that
passion. You can carry your
shared effort
and dreams on the wings of your airplane.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
...!
I thought I robbed him of his dream... I
didn't want to face up to what
I'd done... I
didn't want to acknowledge why I failed!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text: But... I finally get it. I have to acknowledge the good and bad associated with this airplane. I have to continue my teacher's research... I have to carry on his dream!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I'll bear the torch of his efforts and
light
the way to success!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you to say that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's not us who'll carry on your teacher's
dream—only you can do that.
You're the
only one who knows how much he put into
achieving it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's out of the way, allow me
to help. It's time to EX Job
Change!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
From what I've seen of the research notes,
you're particularly skilled in crafting
engines. Therefore,
I'll focus on drafting. Numbers are my
forte, so leave them to me!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
D-drafting?! Then, I'd like to get your
opinion on something...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course. We'll go over even the most
minute of details. Also, there's another
researcher who's taken an interest in the
airplane. We
brought her with us.

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
You took so long to introduce me, I
thought you'd forgotten I was here! Well
met. I specialize in metallurgy—
if you want to know about
metals, then I'm your woman!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! It's a pleasure to meet you! So
you're also interested in
pursuing research
on steel airplanes?

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As a matter of fact, I'd like to
jump right in with a suggestion! How about
using this alloy for the engine? It's
composed of iron ore and a recently
produced mineral...

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
What? It really possesses those kinds of
properties?! Please, tell me
the specific
numbers from your findings!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oho, so the properties of iron in this world do differ from ours. I thought it had an exceedingly wide range of applications.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If we can actually lighten it that much,
then placing the engine here and adjusting
the size of the wings based on the
value of
X would...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, they're getting on like they've
known each other for ages! Their
research
is bound to progress a ton!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When I think of how her teacher's efforts
will finally bear fruit...
Uwaaaagh! I'm so
glad! It's all thanks to Hayahideee!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They're learning from past failures
to recalculate a new and
better formula.
That's Hayahide for you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tickezo. If mistakes aren't meant to
stay as mistakes, then the
same goes for
unfulfilled dreams. There's someone we
need to talk to.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's go together, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Delivery for you!

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text: ...A piece of paper? What's this for?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's an express ticket to your dreams!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna do the test flight at the time
and place written on that
ticket!

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
...!
You don't say... I hope it goes well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Your protégé said she's going to
make your dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We retrieved the old plane, and she's
integrated your combined
research into
the new model.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She completed construction because she
wanted to see your hopes
bear fruit. Don't
you want to be there with her when the
time comes?

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text: But... my dream's already...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's still alive!
Because your student took
up the torch!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everything'll turn out all right!
My ticket is
a one-way express to
certain victory!
